items.original_text: I am working in this field since three years.
items.expected_corrected_text: I have been working in this field for three years.
items.better_expression: I have spent the past three years working in this field.
items.error_span: am working in this field since three years
items.explanation_zh: 谈论从过去持续到现在的经历，应使用现在完成进行时；表示持续时长通常用 for。

items.original_text: My last project make the team more faster.
items.expected_corrected_text: My last project made the team faster.
items.better_expression: My last project helped the team work more efficiently.
items.explanation_zh: 过去项目应用过去式 made；faster 已经是比较级，不需要 more。

items.original_text: I responsible for communicate with customers.
items.expected_corrected_text: I was responsible for communicating with customers.
items.better_expression: I was responsible for communicating with customers and collecting their feedback.
items.explanation_zh: responsible 是形容词，需要 be 动词；介词 for 后面接动名词 communicating。

items.original_text: I think I am suitable to this position.
items.expected_corrected_text: I think I am suitable for this position.
items.better_expression: I believe I would be a strong fit for this position.
items.explanation_zh: suitable 搭配 for 更自然；面试中 strong fit for this position 更地道。

items.original_text: In my previous company, I learn how to lead a small team.
items.expected_corrected_text: In my previous company, I learned how to lead a small team.
items.better_expression: At my previous company, I learned how to lead a small team.
items.explanation_zh: 描述上一家公司发生的经历，应使用过去式 learned；At my previous company 更自然。

items.original_text: I want to know how much salary you can give me.
items.expected_corrected_text: I would like to know the salary range for this role.
items.better_expression: Could you share the expected salary range for this role?
items.error_span: how much salary you can give me
items.explanation_zh: 面试中直接说 give me salary 不够职业；询问 salary range 更礼貌自然。

items.original_text: Can I have a waters?
items.expected_corrected_text: Can I have a glass of water?
items.better_expression: Could I have a glass of water, please?
items.explanation_zh: water 通常是不可数名词，点餐时可说 a glass of water；加 please 更礼貌。

items.original_text: I want the chicken, but no put onions.
items.expected_corrected_text: I want the chicken, but please do not put onions in it.
items.better_expression: Could I have the chicken without onions, please?
items.explanation_zh: no put 不是自然表达；点餐中 without onions 更简洁礼貌。

items.original_text: What you recommend for today?
items.expected_corrected_text: What do you recommend today?
items.better_expression: What would you recommend today?
items.explanation_zh: 疑问句需要助动词 do；would you recommend 更礼貌。

items.original_text: This soup is too much salty.
items.expected_corrected_text: This soup is too salty.
items.better_expression: The soup tastes a bit too salty for me.
items.explanation_zh: 形容词 salty 前直接用 too，不用 too much；a bit too salty 语气更柔和。

items.original_text: Do this dish has nuts?
items.expected_corrected_text: Does this dish have nuts?
items.better_expression: Does this dish contain nuts?
items.explanation_zh: this dish 是第三人称单数，疑问句用 Does；后面动词用原形 have。contain nuts 更适合询问过敏原。

items.original_text: I ordered a pasta but I got the rice.
items.expected_corrected_text: I ordered pasta, but I got rice.
items.better_expression: I ordered pasta, but I think I received rice instead.
items.explanation_zh: pasta 和 rice 通常按不可数名词使用；处理服务问题时 I think I received... 语气更礼貌。

items.original_text: I already finish the report yesterday.
items.expected_corrected_text: I finished the report yesterday.
items.better_expression: I finished the report yesterday and shared it with the team.
items.explanation_zh: yesterday 表示明确过去时间，应使用一般过去时 finished；already 通常不需要。

items.original_text: We need discuss about the timeline.
items.expected_corrected_text: We need to discuss the timeline.
items.better_expression: We need to discuss the timeline and agree on the next milestone.
items.explanation_zh: need 后接 to do；discuss 是及物动词，后面不需要 about。

items.original_text: There is many blockers for this task.
items.expected_corrected_text: There are many blockers for this task.
items.better_expression: There are several blockers that may affect this task.
items.explanation_zh: blockers 是复数，所以应使用 There are。

items.original_text: Can you explain me the new requirement?
items.expected_corrected_text: Can you explain the new requirement to me?
items.better_expression: Could you walk me through the new requirement?
items.explanation_zh: explain 的常见结构是 explain something to someone；walk me through 更适合会议澄清。

items.original_text: I will update you when I will finish it.
items.expected_corrected_text: I will update you when I finish it.
items.better_expression: I will update you as soon as I finish it.
items.explanation_zh: when/as soon as 引导的时间从句中，通常用一般现在时表示将来。

items.original_text: Maybe we can pushing the deadline to Friday.
items.expected_corrected_text: Maybe we can push the deadline to Friday.
items.better_expression: Could we move the deadline to Friday?
items.explanation_zh: 情态动词 can 后接动词原形；move the deadline 更自然。

items.original_text: The data are not enough to make decision.
items.expected_corrected_text: The data is not enough to make a decision.
items.better_expression: We do not have enough data to make a decision yet.
items.explanation_zh: make a decision 需要冠词；在商务语境中用 we do not have enough data 更清楚。

items.original_text: I am very interested about your company culture.
items.expected_corrected_text: I am very interested in your company culture.
items.better_expression: I am very interested in learning more about your company culture.
items.explanation_zh: interested 通常搭配 in；面试提问时 learning more about 更自然。
